title: Carl G. Washburne Memorial State Park
passages: Carl G. Washburne Memorial State Park is a state park in the U.S. state of Oregon, administered by the Oregon Parks and Recreation Department. This park is in Lane County near Florence and Yachats. Very scenic wide beach, great for dogs, kids, kites. Some areas nearby are SNOWY PLOVER protected breeding areas, where dogs are banned, so be careful to keep dogs leashed if uncertain, and always in the State Park itself.
South of the park is the Hobbit Trail trail head located at mile 177.3 or 44.278421°N 124.113499°W﻿ / 44.278421; -124.113499.
"Carl G. Washburne Memorial State Park". Oregon Parks and Recreation Department. Retrieved June 26, 2011.
